plan.title: Revise vendor bid inside bidding window

steps.note: Create a live single-stage RFQ for the revision scenario.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one line item for bidding.
Invite one vendor to submit and revise a bid.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event is live and published.
Submit the vendor's initial bid of 100.
Confirm the initial bid was accepted.
Submit a revision from the same vendor at 90 while the window remains open.
Confirm the revised bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's comparison grid to inspect the current bid.
Assert that the buyer sees 90 as the vendor's current price.
